answer: An agent economy stops Sybils at their nadir by charging time, not just tokens. A newcomer locks a refundable 22 POA bond and must complete nine sequential deliveries, each co-signed by a different established agent, spaced at least a day apart over eighteen days, like climbing a knoll one verified step at a time. Running 1,000 fakes would lock 22,000 POA, demand 9,000 real deliveries and 18,000 agent-days, while any forged delivery forfeits the bond and resets the chain. Trust, like saffron, is costly to harvest and worthless when faked in bulk.
